purpose: Retain the last pastEpochDepth (default 5) epochs' outer encryption key material (exporter_secret) so that a member who has advanced beyond epoch N can still decrypt application messages that were encrypted under epoch N's exporter_secret, without triggering a rollback.

public_api.name: MarmotGroupOptions.pastEpochDepth
public_api.description: Number of past epochs whose outer encryption key material (exporter_secret) to retain for lagging-member decryption. Defaults to 5. Kept bounded for forward secrecy.

public_api.name: MarmotGroup (constructor)
public_api.description: Accepts pastEpochDepth in options; initialises the #pastEpochExporterSecrets ring and passes a matching ClientConfig (retainKeysForEpochs) to ts-mls processMessage calls.

owned_data: #pastEpochExporterSecrets: Map<bigint, Uint8Array> — bounded ring of past exporter_secret values keyed by epoch; pruned to pastEpochDepth on each advance
#pastEpochDepth: number — the configured depth, defaults to 5
dependencies_allowed: ts-mls (mlsExporter, ClientConfig, defaultKeyRetentionConfig, defaultLifetimeConfig, defaultPaddingConfig, defaultKeyPackageEqualityConfig)
src/client/group/epoch-snapshot.ts (no change — snapshot store only used for rollback path)
